title: Meshtastic Gateway – User guide
description: How to read and use the web page: Meshtastic in a nutshell, how the gateway works, every page (Active Nodes, Inbox, Outbox and the Y / S / … / — ACK marks, Chat, Broadcast, Send, Map, Services with wx / taf / cmd solar / cmd wspr, Status and maintenance, Debug), What's new and Guides, running on a Raspberry Pi with update.sh, limitations and a quick reference.
